svg.title: Incident Response Playbooks & SOAR Architecture
svg.desc: Incident Response diagram showing NIST SP 800-61 Rev 2 IR lifecycle (Preparation, Detection, Containment, Recovery), SOAR automation, and Ransomware containment playbooks.
svg.text: NIST SP 800-61 Rev 2 IR lifecycle, SOAR orchestration, and Ransomware containment playbooks.
NIST SP 800-61 REV 2 INCIDENT RESPONSE LIFECYCLE
• 1. PREPARATION: Policy, playbooks, communication channels, tooling & forensic readiness
• 2. DETECTION & ANALYSIS: SIEM alert triage, scope identification, vector analysis, & impact rating
• 3. CONTAINMENT, ERADICATION & RECOVERY: Host isolation, credential revocation, malware purging, & failback
• SOAR Orchestration: Automated EDR network isolation, firewall IP block, & compromised user session termination
• Ransomware Playbook: Isolate affected subnets immediately, revoke Active Directory/IdP tokens, preserve memory
• Post-Incident Activity: Lessons learned meeting, root cause analysis (RCA), & detection rule gap remediation
IR LIFECYCLE: SIEM TRIAGE → SOAR AUTOMATED ISOLATION → ERADICATION & FAILBACK → LESSONS LEARNED RCA
